verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs say it can alert on events from any monitoring tool and integrates with alerting and monitoring tools to create incidents from alerts. They also document a generic webhook event source for ingesting events, but none of the named observability tools appear in the evidence. Missing for 10: named first-party integrations for Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch and Sentry, per-tool setup documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
